h1_statement: No detectable difference between the Hawkes overlay and a decay-weighted trade count. The study could detect effects of 0.0230 bp or larger.
canary_statement: C1, shuffled signs, did not differ detectably from R1. C2, the oracle, beat B1 by 2.3888 bp, more than 3 times the MDE. C3, zero latency: no non-zero latency beat it by more than the MDE or with a bootstrap interval above 0. C4_x0.1 differed from B3; C4_x10 matched B3 within the interval. So the fitted decay is not what drives any gain.
